description: This file defines a React functional component called 'HelloWorld' using the Remotion library for video composition. It imports other components (Logo, Title, Subtitle), uses external libraries like zod for schema validation, and incorporates animation functions from Remotion. It sets up a schema for input props, handles animations for logo movement and fade-out, and composes visual elements with timing control via Sequences.

methods.name: HelloWorld
methods.description: React functional component that renders an animated scene with a logo, title, and subtitle, driven by video frame timing and schema-based props.
